_doc: R-6 (2026-05-14): allowlist for the deployed-vs-git function drift detector.
Entries here are intentionally deployed from a different source than this repo —
usually a legacy companion repo (e.g. sos-backend) that hasn't been migrated yet.
Without this allowlist, the R-6 GHA job would fail on every run because of these.
To add an entry: include the deployed slug + a short reason explaining why the
function lives outside this repo. When the function gets migrated INTO this repo,
remove it from this list and add the source under supabase/functions/<slug>/.
